seo.title: Poisonburst Arrow Pathfinder Build Guide (PoE2 0.5)
seo.description: League-start poison bow with Toxic Growth and Weapon Set 2. Real video, leveling, gear, sources.

changes: Fourth-batch source-reviewed publication. Cross-verified from official 0.5 patch notes, current creator guides, an independent build guide, a planner, a current gameplay video and community questions.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Poisonburst Arrow Pathfinder league-starts with a bow and a 1-Chaos unique (Slivertongue) that carries into T15. You clear maps with Poisonburst Arrow and kill bosses with Gas Arrow plus Toxic Growth. Weapon Set 2 holds the poison skills.
Verification-first: the poison-scaling math and crit-transition come from the current creator guides. The Weapon Set rule and the 'attack speed is feel, not damage' point are the actionable core.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Excellent league starter with a 1-Chaos unique.
Screen-wide poison clear and huge single-target.
cons: Low-budget crit is not worth forcing.
Rangers are flimsy in early acts; do not get hit.

sections.title: Is This Build Right For You?
paragraphs: Pick this if you want a smooth poison league starter that scales into endgame and you can manage Weapon Set 2 for bosses. It is beginner-friendly but not zero-gear.
Get a physical-damage bow early; Slivertongue from Act 3 carries a long way.

steps.label: Act 1-3 - Bow leveling
body: Level with a physical bow and Lightning Arrow, then Poisonburst Arrow once unlocked. Slivertongue from Act 3 carries to T15.

steps.label: Act 4+ - Toxic setup
body: Add Toxic Growth and Gas Arrow; set poison skills to Weapon Set 2 (Rigwald's Ferocity gives more damage there).

steps.label: Maps - Endgame
body: Optimize bow physical, poison magnitude and crit. Benchmark before expensive crit gear.

whyUse: Press and everything dies; the screen-wide poison clear.

skills.role: Spirit gem for clear and pods
Creates the cloud Toxic Growth detonates

mappingBossingDiff: Mapping: Poisonburst Arrow. Bossing: Gas Arrow + Toxic Growth.

sections.title: Poison Scaling Matrix
paragraphs: Poison magnitude, ailment magnitude and damaging-ailment magnitude are three different stats and they all stack. Attack speed feels good but does not directly add damage. Added chaos helps only in specific cases.

sections.title: Weapon Set 2
paragraphs: Poison skills must be set to Weapon Set 2 because Rigwald's Ferocity grants 30% more damage there. Forgetting this silently halves your poison damage.

recommendations: High physical damage is the priority. Slivertongue is the 1-Chaos league-start unique that lasts to T15.
Crit chance, added physical, attributes. Upgrade after the bow.
Flat physical, mana leech, attributes. Plaguefinger is a strong unique option.
Life, resistances, attributes, mana on kill. Fix resistances first.

steps.label: Starter -> Early Endgame
body: Slivertongue, cap resistances, set poison to Weapon Set 2.

steps.label: Early -> Endgame
body: Better bow, add Toxic Growth supports, fix mana.

steps.label: Endgame -> Crit
body: Only after the base is solved; do not force crit early.

sections.title: Crit Transition
paragraphs: Non-crit starter -> once weapon and skill levels are sufficient and crit sources are complete, switch the passive tree and update quiver/amulet -> crit endgame. Do not force crit on a low budget.

sections.title: Budget Variants
paragraphs: League-start uses Slivertongue and a rare bow. Mid adds quiver upgrades and Toxic Growth supports. High-end crit is a separate ceiling, not the league-start requirement.

sections.title: Defensive Layers
paragraphs: Evasion plus permanent slow-immunity (Pathfinder) is the base. Life and a quiver with recovery keep you alive; do not get hit in early acts.

sections.title: Mapping Rotation
paragraphs: For normal packs: press Poisonburst Arrow. Everything dies. Loot. Use Plague Bearer on big packs.

sections.title: Rare Rotation
paragraphs: For rares: Poisonburst Arrow plus Plague Bearer; use Toxic Growth on tanky rares. Keep moving.

sections.title: Boss Rotation
paragraphs: For bosses: cast Gas Arrow, fire Toxic Growth into the cloud until it dissipates, repeat. Stormcaller Arrow applies +70% shock. Do not use the mapping button on bosses.

sections.title: Community Voices

entries.label: Reddit - why is my DPS low
entries.statement: Common cause: poison skills not on Weapon Set 2, or a weak physical bow. Players fix it by moving skills and upgrading the bow.

entries.label: Forum - when to crit
entries.statement: Consensus: do not force crit early; the non-crit base is strong through maps.

entries.label: Guide comments - bow/quiver order
entries.statement: Players note the bow physical roll matters far more than quiver luxuries early.

sections.note: Short paraphrases of common community questions and concerns, edited for clarity. Not verbatim quotes.

items.question: Are leveling and endgame the same build?
answer: They share a base (bow + poison + Weapon Set 2). Endgame optimizes the bow, Toxic Growth supports and crit; the skeleton is the same.

items.question: Why use Gas Arrow + Toxic Growth on bosses?
answer: Toxic Growth detonates the Gas Arrow cloud for large single-target poison. Mapping just spams Poisonburst Arrow; bosses need the cloud combo.

items.question: Why not force crit early?
answer: Crit needs complete sources and a budget the starter lacks. The non-crit base is strong through maps; crit is a late ceiling.

items.question: Why is my DPS lower than the planner?
answer: Usually a weak physical bow, missing Weapon Set 2 for poison, or incomplete Toxic Growth supports. Fix those before chasing gear.

checks: Confirm poison skills are on Weapon Set 2, the bow has physical damage, and Toxic Growth supports are complete.
Add % physical damage leeched as mana on rings/gloves, or 2% mana on kill on jewels.
